code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            comp = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                comp.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))
            r0 = min(y for y,x in comp); r1 = max(y for y,x in comp)
            c0 = min(x for y,x in comp); c1 = max(x for y,x in comp)
            if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
                continue
            # A rectangular frame: every perimeter cell has the component color.
            if (all(grid[r0][x] == color and grid[r1][x] == color for x in range(c0,c1+1)) and
                all(grid[y][c0] == color and grid[y][c1] == color for y in range(r0,r1+1))):
                for y in range(r0+1, r1):
                    for x in range(c0+1, c1):
                        out[y][x] = 7
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
print('saved',p)
